system.description: A name for the system (an identifier)

ground.description: Element the GDS connects to; default: the first

output.description: Default: wsts/<system>, relative to this file

manifest.description: Deployment manifest, relative to this file

ids.description: IDs routed to this element; its WSTS instances go inside

bridge.description: Default: the manifest's, else tcp:50100, tcp:50101, ...

gds.description: false: leave this element's dictionary out of the one the GDS uses (and out of its version check), for an element whose items reach the ground only as another element's; not for the ground element. Default: true

name.description: Also the name faults are addressed by

kind.description: bytestream: a connected stream socket. gpio: a discrete wire, a level from the pin flight software at end a writes to an input at end b. datagram: connectionless datagrams, one message each; a send while the peer is absent is dropped in real time, and held in lockstep

a.description: <element>.<instance>: a byte stream or GPIO driver instance (qualified names work too). A gpio link may instead end at an endpoint the element declares under gpio_endpoints

b.description: <element>.<instance>: a byte stream or GPIO driver instance (qualified names work too). A gpio link may instead end at an endpoint the element declares under gpio_endpoints

dynamics.description: Plants: dynamics simulators stepped between instants in stepped time (docs/dynamics.md). Their outputs are bridge actions, journaled like a client's

name.description: The plant's name: its trace is wsts-logs/dynamics-<name>.jsonl, and its actions carry "via": <name>

python.description: A Python file, relative to the manifest, that defines create(params): an object with step(t, dt, inputs) -> outputs

fmu.description: An FMI 2.0 or 3.0 co-simulation FMU, relative to the manifest

params.description: Given to create(params), or set on the FMU's parameters by name before initialisation

step.description: Seconds of simulated time per exchange; default: every instant

element.description: The element read or written (may be left out when the system has one element)

gpio.description: A GPIO endpoint: the level flight software last wrote (1 or 0)

model.description: A model of the manifest: its value 'key' (model_get)

key.description: The model's key (text of a ScriptedByteStream, reg.<offset> of a RegisterFile, a register of a RegisterMapI2c, ...)

register.description: A register endpoint: the register at 'offset', read without a flight read

inputs.description: The plant's inputs by name: where each is read, after an instant

element.description: The element read or written (may be left out when the system has one element)

gpio.description: A GPIO endpoint: driven as an input of flight software (an edge when the level changes)

model.description: A model of the manifest: model_set of 'key'

key.description: The model's key (text of a ScriptedByteStream, reg.<offset> of a RegisterFile, a register of a RegisterMapI2c, ...)

register.description: A register endpoint: reg_set of the register at 'offset'

i2c.description: An I2C endpoint: i2c_reg_set of register 'reg' of the register-addressed model at 'addr'

bytes.description: A byte stream endpoint: the 'format'ted text injected when it changes

round.description: To the nearest whole number (implied for registers)

format.description: Python format string of the value, e.g. "$TEMP,{:.1f}\n"

above.description: A threshold: true while the value is above it

below.description: A threshold: true while the value is below it

hysteresis.description: How far back past the threshold the value must go to change again

outputs.description: The plant's outputs by name: where each is written (one place, or a list), before the next instant, when it changes

socket.description: A plant served in a process of its own, over the plant socket protocol (fprime_wsts.plant_socket): its address, or the address and the command that starts the server

address.description: tcp:<host>:<port>, tcp:<port> or unix:<path>; port 0: a free port, chosen at run time

command.description: The server's command line, run in the manifest's directory; {address} and {port} are replaced

fortytwo.description: NASA's 42, stepped over its TXRX socket (fprime_wsts.fortytwo): its case directory, or the case and 42's executable

case.description: The case directory (Inp_Sim.txt, Inp_IPC.txt), relative to the manifest

executable.description: 42's executable; default: $FORTYTWO, else 42 on the PATH. A path starting with ./ or ../ is relative to the manifest
